operation.name: EqualityOfVariance
operation.friendly-name: Equality of variance (Levene, Bartlett) and Welch's F

steps.report:
Approximate equality of variance tests and adjusted ANOVA

Levene's (W50) F = @{f:roundx} (df = @df1, @df2) @{pLevene:pval}

Bartlett's chi-square = @{x2:roundx} df = @df @{pBartlett:pval}

Welch adjusted ANOVA F = @{fWelch:roundx} (df = @dfnWelch, @{dfdWelch:roundx}) @{pWelch:pval}
